description: AI-protected content manifest for \aikeep{} and \aianchor{} blocks

blocks.content: We evaluate the annotation system on a single representative paper.

Explicit annotations let AI agents edit a paper without eroding its
carefully chosen wording.

Collaborating with AI agents on a paper requires a way to mark which
text is negotiable and which is not.

A \emph{protected block} is a span of text that an AI agent must never
modify, under any instruction.
